set.body: Parent AC1-3. Extend existing TemporalSupport/TemporalQuery with annotation-axis query admission, checked recall exposure tied to RecallTiming/clock/inventory/mapping/policy. Explicit intervals preserve gaps; overlap requires declared policy; onset-only remains point exposure, never infer end from next onset. Preserve failed/uncomputed exposure and separate original ledgers. Retain inference-unit ids through word navigation. Distinguish normalized scores, probability and transport without renormalization (transport total 2 remains 2). Multiple simultaneous referents require checked decomposition or explicit unsupported status. ADR0019 records exact semantics/rejected alternatives. Courts: separated intervals, overlap, final onset-only word, failed unit, duplicate display words, foreign joins, >2^53 annotation ticks. Independent exact-SHA review, compiled guard mutations, scoped serial gate and required consumer witnesses.
set.title: [temporal] Checked temporal exposure and measure semantics
